# Consensus without a central brain: spec

## 0. What "no central brain" means operationally
Reducer = pure deterministic function of (vote set, pinned constants, 32-byte chain head). No learning, no judgment, no mutable opinion. Everything else lives in stateless workers. Statelessness is load-bearing: full replay determinism.

## 1. Setup & notation
- Round r, input x_r. Workers i=1..N_r respond. Candidate space: discrete labels c ∈ {c_1..c_K} (K measured/pinned) or continuous scores.
- Diversity injected deterministically: seed_i(r,a) = H(ver ‖ canon(x_r) ‖ i ‖ a), a = attempt counter. temp_i = pinned schedule g(i). Same (x_r, ver) ⇒ same vote multiset ⇒ replayable.
- Canon(x): JSON-canonical, keys sorted, numbers quantized to Δ_q (pinned), whitespace stripped. All hashing/voting on canon form only.

## 2. Measured signals
Offline (calibration suite C, pinned; re-measure on any version bump):
- M1 p̄ — single-worker accuracy on C. Scalar.
- M2 ε_i — per-worker error/disagreement rate on C.
- M3 σ_cal, MAD-cal distribution — score dispersion stats on C.
- M4 (μ_D, σ_D) — rolling drift-distance stats from a pinned 10^4-round shadow run.
- M5 MV(k) — marginal-value curve of k scouts on C.
Live (every round, computed in the reduce):
- L1 N_r — responders.
- L2 V_r(c) — tally per candidate (integers).
- L3 H̃_r — normalized vote entropy.
- L4 MAD_r / CV_r — live dispersion.
- L5 D_r — EMA of 1 − cos(e(o*_r), e(anchor)); embedder hash pinned.
- L6 η_r — burn efficiency = committed/burned tokens.
- L7 gate-failure counters by cause.

## 3. Closed-form decision rules
R1 Fleet sizing: N* = min odd N: Σ_{j=(N+1)/2}^{N} C(N,j) p̄^j (1−p̄)^{N−j} ≥ 1−α.
R2 Per-round accept (discrete): c* = argmax V_r(c), ties → smallest canon-hash. Emit iff V_r(c*) ≥ t(N_r, K, α), t = min{v: Σ_{j=v}^N C(N,j)(1/K)^j(1−1/K)^{N−j} ≤ α}. Elementary fallback: t ≥ N_r/K + sqrt(N_r ln(1/α)/2).
R3 Continuous: o* = geometric median of quantized scores; emit iff MAD_r ≤ MAD_99(C) and (if reference exists) |o* − θ_ref| ≤ z_{1−α/2} σ_cal sqrt(π/(2N_r)).
R4 Admission: worker in fleet iff ε_i ≤ μ_ε + 3σ_ε.
R5 Scout count: k* = min{k: P_maj(k) ≥ 1−α_eff} using same binomial tail with p̄; equivalently grow k while MV(k) ≥ λ (λ = token-cost/error-cost ratio, pinned from business constraint).
R6 Drift alarms: (a) chain break ⇒ halt, replay from last anchor; (b) D_r > μ_D + 3.09σ_D ⇒ halt, replay; (c) H̃_r > H_max pinned ⇒ treat as failed gate (too scattered to speak).
R7 Escalation: fail ⇒ retry with a+1 (fresh deterministic seeds), max A=2; then deterministic greedy fallback, flagged low-confidence. Voice never silent, never plural.

## 5. Why no drift (mechanism map)
Table: drift source → mechanism → measured tripwire.
- Worker nondeterminism → canonicalization + quantization + integer reduce → L2/L4 stability.
- Scheduling order → deterministic tie-break, order-free tally → replay equality.
- Churn → N_r enters threshold explicitly → R2 self-adjusts.
- Bad workers → M2/R4 admission → ε stats.
